question: Who among the following wrote the book 'Straight from the Heart'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev** wrote the book 'Straight from the Heart'.
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer and captain, who led India to victory in the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• The book provides an insight into his life, career, and the challenges he faced on and off the field.
 
• It reflects his journey, achievements, and the lessons he learned throughout his cricketing career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev** is widely regarded as one of the greatest all-rounders in the history of cricket.
 
• He was named the Indian Cricketer of the Century in 2002 by Wisden.
 
• His contributions to Indian cricket have been immense, making him a national icon and a source of inspiration for aspiring cricketers.
 
• In addition to his cricketing career, Kapil Dev has also served as a cricket coach and commentator.
